claims.claim: HelpHub Assistant is an AI-powered chatbot marketed for instant 24/7 customer support, requiring no coding to set up.

excerpts.excerpt: Boost your business with HelpHub Assistant, an AI-powered chatbot for instant 24/7 customer support. Fast setup, no coding, PayPal secure payment, instant access!

claims.claim: The company claims its chatbot integrates with payment platforms including PayPal and Stripe, and supports multiple languages.

excerpts.excerpt: Integration with PayPal, Stripe, and major payment platforms

claims.caveat: This is a self-description on the homepage; no independent certification or documentation is provided.
claims.claim: The company describes the product as GDPR-compliant.
The company offers a live demo of the chatbot without registration or payment.

excerpts.excerpt: Curious how our chatbot works in real life? Test the HelpHub Assistant AI Chatbot live here! No registration or payment required - just try it out and see how it can help your business.

claims.caveat: This figure is attributed to an external study but is only presented via the company's own blog, with no link or verification of the cited study.
claims.claim: The company's blog cites a 2023 IBM study claiming a 30-40% reduction in customer service costs from AI chatbot deployment.

excerpts.excerpt: According to a 2023 IBM study, businesses deploying AI chatbots see an average reduction of 30-40% in customer service costs.

claims.caveat: Source of this statistic is unnamed and unverifiable from the supplied material.
claims.claim: The blog cites a claim that 75% of consumers expect responses within five minutes.

excerpts.excerpt: Research shows that 75% of consumers expect answers within five minutes when contacting customer support.

claims.caveat: No company names, sources, or verification are given; these read as illustrative examples rather than confirmed customers.
claims.claim: The blog describes anecdotal/example case studies (a boutique and a repair service) with specific improvement percentages, but these appear to be illustrative examples rather than verified customer case studies.

excerpts.excerpt: A small online boutique integrated a chatbot to answer product size questions and recommend items based on user preferences. Within six months, they saw a 25% increase in average order value and a significant drop in support tickets.
